verdict.rationale: Lovable's Git sync connects a project to a repo you own on GitHub/GitLab and keeps them in sync automatically, supports local IDE workflows (clone, edit, commit, push, sync back), and enables PR review, branch testing, and external deployment — covering true two-way sync and code ownership. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of sync reliability and no community commentary specifically confirming bidirectional sync works smoothly in practice.
